name: fastnav
title: FastNav
description: Search and run commands and visible controls from any running macOS application.
author: uriafranko

commands.name: search-app-actions
commands.title: Search App Actions
commands.description: Search accessibility actions, menu commands, and keyboard shortcuts across running apps.

preferences.name: searchAllApplications
preferences.title: Search Across All Applications
preferences.description: Search every running application and rank actions from the previously focused application higher. Turn this off to search only the previously focused application.
preferences.label: Search actions from all running applications

preferences.name: includeInterfaceElements
preferences.title: Include Visible Interface Elements
preferences.description: Include actionable buttons, links, tabs, rows, and controls from each app's focused window.
preferences.label: Include visible buttons, links, tabs, rows, and controls
